out.ability: Distortion (3 SPI): The Baron of Corruption can use the loopholes found in Order. By distorting the target's words, actions, and intent, they can formulate a certain Order that provides them with an advantage, restraining and influencing their opponent. They can distort the direction and target of attacks. They can Seal ordinary rooms or Unseal confined spaces. The extent to which they can distort the direction and target of attacks is at the GM's discretion. Corrosion (2 SPI): The Baron of Corruption can turn the hearts of people within 10 metres dark and greedy, making them make irrational choices.
out.name: Baron of Corruption
out.reinforcedAbilities: Bribery — All Effects: The Briber's Weaken penalty increases to -6 (from -4). Charm's Will penalty increases to -5 (from -3). Connection's bonus increases to +4 (from +2). The Diminishing Rule still applies. Eloquence: The Baron of Corruption may use Eloquence as a free action once per scene to impose the Arrogance effect on a target within 10 m without spending SPI. The target rolls IQ-2 as usual.

out.ability: Prohibition (2 SPI): Speak in Ancient Hermes to forbid certain actions or Beyonder powers within a 10-meter radius — no contest required. Format: "'X' is Prohibited here". Examples: Flight, Teleportation, Invisibility. Violators suffer -12 to all rolls involving the prohibited action. Targets with SPI higher than the Judge's suffer -6 instead. Cannot kill specific individuals — suppresses or repels them instead. Suppressed if the target is 3+ Sequences above the Judge. Imprison (2 SPI): Range: LOS, up to 15 m. Freezes one target in place. Breaking free requires ST-4 or Escape-4 each turn. Roots Spirit Body-type creatures, but cannot prevent escape via Substitution abilities. Declare "Release" to end early. Confinement (2 SPI): Range: LOS, up to 10 m. Area variant of Imprison — immaterial cell around a designated area, impenetrable by Spirit Bodies. Circumvents Substitution — targets reappear within boundaries. Can seal a room against entry or exit. Maintain Secrecy (1 SPI): Eye contact. Quick Contest: Judge's SPI vs. target's Will. On failure, the target cannot voluntarily reveal the Judge's secrets or disobey a simple instruction for 1 hour, and must actively conceal them. Mind-affecting compulsion. May release early. Death (3 SPI): Declare target Dead, then charge. Roll Brawling or DX to hit (no hit-location penalty). Deals 2× swing crushing damage, with no hit-location wounding multiplier — the blow lands wherever fate wills. Flog (1 SPI): Swing hand to strike with an invisible whip. Roll Brawling +2 or DX +2 to hit. Deals 2d+3 cutting; ignores 1 DR. Invisible — unaware targets cannot defend unless they suspect attack. Exile (X SPI): Speak "Exile" to blast the target away. Per SPI spent (1-5), hurl target 20 meters in a chosen direction. Target rolls HT-4 to halve distance. Affects Spirit Bodies. Collision deals 1d crushing per 10 meters travelled (or fraction).
out.advantages: Ancient Hermes Fluent — can speak, read, and write this dead mystical language
out.name: Judge
out.reinforcedAbilities: Authority: Still costs 1 SPI to activate for the scene. Aura forces anyone meeting the Judge's eyes to roll Will or suffer -1 to attack rolls against the Judge for that turn. Can subtly influence environment within 10 m (still air, dim lights, quiet sounds). Authority's -1 penalty applies to all hostile actions within earshot that violate the Judge's stated rules. Jurisdiction: Maximum range approaches the size of Backlund. While inside Jurisdiction, the Judge gains +2 to Law, Intimidation, and Administration rolls.

out.ability: Analysis (1 SPI): Roll Thaumatology to analyze a Beyonder power used by an opponent. Bonuses by target Sequence: +3 (Seq 9), +2 (Seq 8), +1 (Seq 7), +0 (Seq 6), -3 (Seq 5), -8 (Seq 4). Success reveals the exact details of the ability. Failure wastes the SPI — no information gained. Imitation (2 SPI): After a successful Analysis, imitate the analyzed power. Roll Thaumatology. Bonus based on Analysis margin of success:  +0 (by 0-2) → 20% efficiency  +2 (by 3-5) → 35% efficiency  +4 (by 6+) → 50% efficiency  +6 (crit) → 50% efficiency (Seq 4 powers do not receive the crit bonus) Damage abilities deal half damage at all efficiency levels. Non-damage abilities have range or effect reduced proportionally. Can imitate passive powers (Danger Premonition, Fate powers) and active powers (Recording). Cannot imitate Authorities at any Sequence.
out.advantages: Jack-of-all-trade Reduce study time by half
out.name: Polymath

out.ability: Wind Control (3 SPI): Surround yourself with howling winds for 1 minute. Ranged attacks against you suffer -4 to hit. Melee attackers within 2 m must roll ST or be pushed back 1d m. Windblades (3 SPI): Create invisible sharp wind blades at range. Roll Throwing or DX to hit. Deals 3d+3 cutting. Range 20/40 m. Target may dodge. Flight (1 SPI): Fly at Basic Move ×1.5, max altitude 10 m. Duration 1 minute (extend at 1 SPI/min). Floating Wind (1 SPI): Hover in place up to 1 m off the ground for 1 minute. Wind Footing (1 SPI): Generate wind beneath feet — Move ×2 for 1 minute. Glide (1 SPI): Glide at normal Move, losing 1 m altitude per 3 m forward. Functions even if Flight is Prohibited by a Judge. Wind Fist (1 SPI): Imbue fists with spiraling wind for 1 minute. Unarmed strikes deal +1d crushing damage. Wind Manipulation (1 SPI): Use wind to carry small objects (up to 1 kg) to your hand within 10 m. Also eavesdrop on conversations within 20 m via wind vibrations. Duration 1 minute. Wind Cushion (X SPI): Reactive. When you would take damage, spend SPI to create an air cushion. Gain DR 3 per SPI spent against that single instance. Decide before damage is rolled. Water Control (X SPI): Manipulate and shape water within 10 m. 1 SPI for simple shapes or moving water; 2 SPI for complex manipulation (GM discretion). Deep Dive (Passive): Dive to 100 m depth without pressure penalties. Float (1 SPI): Float on water without sinking for 10 minutes. Night Vision (Passive): See clearly in darkness up to normal vision range.
out.drawbacks: Irascible GM may remind the player to roleplay irritability matching a gale. Refusing to act irascible when appropriate may incur a penalty at GM discretion.
out.name: Wind-blessed

out.ability: Mental Fortitude (Passive): The Prometheus has hardened their mind against mental corruption. Reduce any CoR gained from purely mental sources (psychic attacks, madness-inducing effects, mental influence, and similar effects) by 3 (minimum 0). This does not protect against physical or spiritual corruption. Superior Observation (Passive): The Prometheus can directly sense where valuable items are within a 50-meter range, their approximate value, and possible types. Unless there are Beyonder powers of Concealment that can resist this type of perception, no treasure can escape a Prometheus' nose. Steal (1+ SPI): The Prometheus can steal many things within a 50 m radius. Steal Beyonder Power (2 SPI): Choose a target and a specific Beyonder power you have witnessed them use. Roll Thaumatology with modifiers:  +4 per Sequence below the Prometheus  -4 per Sequence above the Prometheus  +2 if you have studied or witnessed the target's power multiple times  -2 if the power is poorly understood or unfamiliar Success: you steal that power and may use it freely for the next 10 minutes at its full potency. The target loses access to the power for at least 12 hours. A power already activated before the theft continues functioning normally. Steal Object (1 SPI): Roll Sleight of Hand to covertly steal a visible object from a target within 50 m (a held item, worn necklace, pocketed key) or to slip a held object into a target's pocket or hand within the same range. Resisted by the target's Per if they might notice, or by an opposed Sleight of Hand roll if they are alert. Steal Fire (1 SPI): Steal flame itself — extinguish any non-magical fire within 50 m immediately. Magical fire (Beyonder flames) requires a Thaumatology roll at -2 to extinguish.
out.name: Prometheus
out.reinforcedAbilities: Decryption: Decryption now requires only 1 minute of concentration (instead of the usual time) for mundane subjects, and 5 minutes for mystical subjects. The Prometheus automatically receives at least a Standard fact on any successful roll. Beyonder Knowledge: By handling a mystical item or ritual component for 1 turn, the Prometheus intuitively senses its general purpose and relative danger — no roll required. Superior Observation: The Cryptologist's trained observation range expands to 50 m, now matching the Prometheus's innate range. The Prometheus can sense whether a concealed target within range is a Beyonder, though not their specific Sequence or pathway. Detect Lies and Body Language rolls gain +4 (from +3). Mental Disruption: The Will penalty increases to -6. The Prometheus may target up to 3 individuals simultaneously by spending 3 SPI total. Reminder / Theft: Reminder distance increases to 15 m. The Prometheus can now steal spiritual materials that are actively in use by a target (e.g., a talisman being held ready for casting) by winning a Quick Contest of Thaumatology vs. the target's Will.

out.ability: Record (1 SPI): After witnessing an active Beyonder power being used, roll 3d6 against the target below based on the power's origin Sequence. Success stores one use of that power; failure wastes the SPI. Only active (not passive) powers can be Recorded. Record target (roll 3d6 ≤ target): Seq 7-9: 15 | Seq 6: 11 | Seq 5: 9 | Seq 4: 5 (cannot succeed even after 10 attempts) Storage slots: 1 Demigod-level power (2 after full digestion), 8 Seq 5-6 powers, 20 Seq 7-9 powers. If a Seq 7 power is demonstrated by a Seq 5 Beyonder and stored in a Seq 7 slot, it manifests at Seq 6 level.
out.name: Scribe
out.reinforcedAbilities: Interference: The SPI contest for anti-divination gains +3 in the Scribe's favour. The Scribe may extend Interference to cover a 10 m radius around themselves for 2 SPI, protecting all allies within. Door Opening / Peephole: Door Opening can now bring up to 5 people through a spatial obstacle. Peephole thickness limit increases to 2 m.

out.ability: Spider's Threads: The Pleasure can spread spider-like, almost invisible silk threads from her hair that can be used for various purposes. Basic Spider Threads Trap (1 SPI / free outside battle): The Pleasure places her threads to create a detection mechanism. She can easily detect when her silk is destroyed. In battle, this reveals the enemy's size, relative strength, and speed. Noticing the threads requires a Per roll at -5. Threads Cocoon (2 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure rapidly spins a cocoon of threads around herself as a protective barrier. She recovers +1 HP/turn (at the start of her turn) while inside. The cocoon possesses the Pleasure's maximum SPI in HP. When the cocoon is destroyed, remaining damage is transferred to the Pleasure (e.g., if the cocoon has 4 HP remaining and an attack deals 7 damage, the cocoon is destroyed and the Pleasure takes the remaining 3 HP of damage). Pleasure Shock (2 SPI): If the enemy has made contact with the Pleasure's threads, she can cause them to experience "true pleasure" — spasms and loss of bodily control. The target must roll Will -4; on failure they lose control of their body for 1d turns. Thread Entanglement (2 SPI): The Pleasure shoots out a mass of threads that restrain her enemy. Breaking free requires a ST -4 or Escape -3 roll. Charm (Passive): The Pleasure's beauty and charm are significantly enhanced. Any man who comes into contact with her must roll Will -2 or be charmed. The longer someone is in her presence, the harder the Will roll becomes to break free from infatuation (GM's discretion). This also affects homosexual men and, to a lesser degree, women. The Pleasure may hide her beauty by using the Disguise skill at -2 to negate this effect. Dark Magic: The Pleasure's dark magic is enhanced. Cleansing Black Flame (1 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure ignites a silent black flame within her body to cleanse curses, negative influences, or purge ghosts/wraiths. Wraiths inside her take 2d+1 damage per turn. Spirit Body Trap (4 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure encases a spiritual creature in layers of frost and black fire to contain it. The spiritual creature must roll SPI -5 to break out. Black Flame Bullets (1 SPI per 2 bullets): The Pleasure creates up to 7 black flames around her and launches them at opponents. Roll Thaumatology to hit. Each bullet deals 2d damage and then ignites the target for 1d damage/turn while burning. Burning persists until the target's SPI drops below 1/3 max (rounded down) or the flames are extinguished. Ice Barrier (2 SPI + 1 SPI/turn): The Pleasure encases herself or an ally within reach in an ice barrier. The barrier has SPI + 4 HP. After destruction, remaining damage is negated. Ice Spear (3 SPI): The Pleasure conjures a spear of pure ice that pierces mystical defences. Roll Thaumatology to hit. On impact, deals 5d+2 damage. Mirror Magic: The Pleasure can cast her curses on an enemy if she manages to reflect the enemy's entire figure in a mirror. Mirror and Stave Substitution (3 SPI): The Pleasure's mirror substitution can now be performed up to twice per turn and heals her for +1 HP and +1 FP.
out.advantages: Charisma +1 +1 to Influence skills; NPCs predisposed to trust you Throat Control cannot be easily choked — immune to chokeholds and neck-crushing techniques Greater Acute Vision +4 to all vision-based Perception rolls; allows the Pleasure to see their own Spider's Threads Appearance (Very Beautiful) striking appearance draws attention and favourable treatment (GM discretion)
out.name: Demoness of Pleasure
out.reinforcedAbilities: Black Flames: The Pleasure's black flames deal +2 damage per die (minimum +1) against spirit bodies. Flames can now be extinguished only by reducing the target's SPI below 1/4 of maximum (from 1/3). Flame Compression: Damage increases to 3d6 (from 2d6). Blast radius expands to 15 m (from 10 m). The compressed sphere may also be split into 2 smaller spheres (1d6+2 each) targeting separate enemies. Freeze — Target: HT penalty increases to -3 (from -1). Damage increases to 3d6-1 (from 2d6-1). May freeze up to 2 cubic meters. Mirror Magic — Hide: Duration increases to 1 minute (from 1d6 seconds). If the mirror is destroyed, the Pleasure takes only 1d6 damage (from 2d6).

out.ability: Scroll Making (1+ SPI): The Scrolls Professor can create magical scrolls from various materials. The Warlock's Spell Creation system is upgraded — any spell the Professor has designed or learned can be inscribed into a scroll for instant later use. Creating a Scroll: Roll Alchemy to prepare the material (parchment, ink, or leather infused with spiritual components), then roll Thaumatology to inscribe the spell's mystical pattern. Failure on either roll simply wastes the materials — the scroll is not created but no SPI is lost. Additional scroll types may be created with GM approval. Using a Scroll: On a later turn, recite the corresponding incantation as a Ready maneuver. The scroll burns and releases its stored ability immediately — no concentration or casting time required. The SPI cost was paid at creation time; the user only needs a free hand to hold and activate the scroll. Some of the Scroll Spells the Scrolls Professor can create include: Secret Voice: Forms a channel linking 3 to 5 people within 50 meters, allowing communication without obstruction. Lasts 10 minutes. Freezing: Creates a stream of crystal clear light that freezes the target. The target suffers -3 to all rolls, and halves Basic Move and Dodge for 1d6 turns. If a second Freezing scroll is used on the same target within 1 minute, the target is sealed in ice — break free with ST-3. Storm: Creates a wide thunderstorm centred on the user. Deals 3d6 damage to all in a 10 m radius. Half damage on HT-2 save. Numb: Releases a light green luster that paralyzes a single target within 20 m. The target is Stunned and may resist with Will-3 at the start of each turn. Burning: Releases flames that engulf a 5 m radius. Deals 1d6 burning damage, plus 1d6 per turn for 1d3 turns unless the target uses an action to extinguish the flames. Wind: A swift wind envelops a selected target within 20 m, doubling their Basic Move and granting +3 to Dodge for 1 minute. Healing: Releases a green light that heals all allies within a 10 m radius for 1d6 HP. Sun: Releases a holy light aura in a 10 m radius. Deals 3d6 damage to undead and evil creatures. No effect on living creatures.
out.name: Scrolls Professor
out.reinforcedAbilities: Eyes of Mystery Prying: The Scrolls Professor can read the contents of any written mystical text (scrolls, grimoires, encrypted notes) by touch alone — no roll required. The passive penalty to Dream/Illusion rolls against the Professor increases to -5. Quick Rituals: The time reduction for known rituals improves to -6 (from -5). The Professor can perform rituals at 1/3 the listed time (minimum 1 minute), and may maintain concentration on one ritual while taking Attack or All-Out Defense actions. Spirit Contract: Maximum simultaneous contracts increases to 8 (from 4). The Professor may now inscribe a Spirit Contract onto a scroll — anyone who reads and activates the scroll is bound by the contract's terms as if they had negotiated it themselves.

out.ability: Manufacturing (1 SPI): The Artisan is an undisputed master of creation. To craft a Sealed Artifact, the Artisan first makes a crafting skill roll (Smith, Jeweler, Machinist, etc.) to manufacture the item from the Beyonder Characteristic, then rolls Thaumatology with a bonus equal to the margin of success from the crafting roll. The Sealed Artifact gains better effects and fewer negative side effects depending on how well the Thaumatology roll succeeds. If the Characteristic is from a higher or lower Sequence, apply ±2 to the Thaumatology roll per Sequence difference. Failing the Thaumatology roll means reduced power and increased drawbacks — the item is still created but flawed. To create a Mystical Item (without a Beyonder Characteristic), the Artisan follows the same process. The item's longevity depends on success margin: 0–2 = 6 months, 3–5 = 1 year, 6–8 = 2 years, Critical Success = 3 years. The Artisan can also fix Spirit World summoning rituals (such as Messenger contracts) directly into an item — anyone who possesses the item may activate the summoning without knowing the ritual.
out.name: Artisan
out.reinforcedAbilities: Appraisal: The Artisan's Appraisal sense is now reflexive. They may identify a Beyonder item's purpose, dangers, and domain alignment as a free action. For rare or complex items, roll Appraisal — on success, all immediate dangers are revealed (not just one). Items lower than the Artisan's own Sequence are identified automatically. Rapid Manufacturing: The Artisan may reduce the manufacturing time for crafting by half. For items of the Artisan's own Sequence or lower, they may attempt to craft a rushed version in 1/4 the normal time (minimum 1 hour), taking -3 to the crafting roll.

out.ability: Psychological Invisibility (Free, No SPI Cost): The Hypnotist can remain in the blind spot of one's consciousness. This works even against Spirit Vision and a Hunter's Danger Intuition (until the user prepares to strike). The target will not perceive the user even when standing right before them. Strong interactions with the surroundings can break the invisibility. At this Sequence, can work on multiple targets simultaneously.
out.advantages: DR +3 Dragon Scales — draconic scales beneath the skin provide DR 3 against all physical damage
out.name: Hypnotist
out.reinforcedAbilities: Hypnosis: Psychological Cue undergoes a qualitative change, becoming Hypnosis. Non-Combat Hypnosis (2 SPI): Open the door and enter the target's Body of Heart and Mind. The target rolls Will-6 to resist. The target will not notice they are following the Hypnotist's arrangements. Cannot directly harm the target's life. Battle Hypnotism (2 SPI): Forcefully hypnotize an enemy mid-combat. The target rolls Will-6 to resist. Lasts 1 turn. The Hypnotist can make the target perform an action that does not threaten their own life.

out.ability: Notarization: By utilizing a language that stirs the powers of nature along with the relevant words, a Notary can achieve Authentication, Amplification, or Nullification. Authentication (1 SPI): Determine the authenticity of various things such as potion formulas, and enforce Contracts. Once a signature is provided as confirmation, even a Sequence 5 Beyonder cannot violate it, and a Sequence 4 Demigod would have great difficulty. Those who lie or break the Contract are engulfed in burning golden flames, suffering 15d damage. Amplification (2 SPI): A valid Notarization temporarily enhances a targeted Beyonder power. Proclaim "God says it's effective!" The effect depends on the GM. Nullification (2 SPI): An invalid Notarization weakens or forcefully disperses a targeted Beyonder power. Proclaim "God says it's ineffective!" Powers of all kinds, including verbal command abilities, authorities, and traits can be affected.
out.advantages: DR 1 Fire/Light — resistance to fire and light-based attacks
out.name: Notary

out.ability: Flesh & Blood Magic (Passive): A Rose Bishop can stack up to 50 Stacks of Flesh and Blood; 1 Stack equals 1 HP. They can use Stacks as a free action to regenerate. A Rose Bishop must regularly replenish their Flesh and Blood. If they have less than 10 Stacks, they double any corruption they would take. They can use the Flesh and Blood of corpses in their immediate surroundings. A corpse equals 25 Flesh and Blood Stacks. Flesh Cloak (X Flesh and Blood): Create cloaks of sticky Flesh that resist magic and reduce damage. The cloak has 1 HP per Flesh used and DR 3 against Beyonder Powers. Flesh Blood Fusion (0 Flesh and Blood): Melt into pure sticky Flesh and Blood that can penetrate the ground and move. Halves all damage except large-area damage (which deals double). Can hide inside a host's stomach — the host dies upon the Rose Bishop's departure. Takes 3 turns to blend in. Flesh Bomb (5 Flesh and Blood): Tear off flesh to make explosive Flesh Bombs that explode into corrosive blood rain, dealing 3d Corrosive damage. Can be buried inside others' bodies and detonated. Flesh Blood Servants (15 Flesh and Blood): Create puppets with immense strength (ST 17), immune to spirit attacks. 15 HP. Self-destruct deals 5d damage in a 3 m radius. Flesh Blood Curse (0 Flesh and Blood): Curse a target if possessing their flesh (+2) and/or blood (+4). Use Ritualistic Magic to inflict 3d damage or for other rituals. Devouring (0 Flesh and Blood): Envelop a target, corrode their body from the inside, dealing 2d damage per turn. Flesh Softening (0 Flesh and Blood): Negate the next instance of physical damage except from knives and swords (which slash through). Disguise (0 Flesh and Blood): Modify appearance (muscularity, facial features) with practice. While in disguise, NPCs who scrutinise you may notice something off (GM discretion).
out.name: Rose Bishop

out.ability: Spiritual Vision (Passive – Reinforced): The Soul Assurer sees spiritual lifeforms at all times without activating Spirit Vision. Constant exposure grants +3 to Spiritual Perception rolls (Ch. 4) and makes it impossible for spirits to hide within line of sight. Requiem (2 SPI): Cause the target's Spirit Body to fall asleep. The target skips 2 turns (stimuli — being damaged, shaken, or a loud noise on their turn — wakes them immediately). Will-5 to resist; on success only halves Basic Move and Basic Speed for 1 turn and the target suffers -5 to Spiritual Intuition rolls (Ch. 4) for the same duration. On unwilling spirits, ghosts, and undead: Will-4 or forced into silent slumber. On willing allies: heal the Spirit Body, reducing Corruption by 1d3 points. Agitate (1 SPI): Agitate the target's Spirit Body, heightening their frustrations and destructive urges. The target must perform an offensive action this turn instead of fleeing or hesitating (Will-2 to resist). On a successful Divination Arts roll, one hidden psychological flaw or spiritual corruption in the target is revealed.
out.name: Soul Assurer
out.reinforcedAbilities: Dream Invasion: Range increased to 150 m (from 20 m quick / 100 m prepared). Midnight Poem: The Soul Assurer may manifest Midnight Poem effects through song instead of recitation. Nocturnality: The Soul Assurer requires only 2 hours of rest per day (down from 3–4). Night bonuses increase to +3 to all rolls (from +2).

out.ability: Language of the Dead: Speak a mystical language that urges a target's Spirit to leave its body, bypassing physical protection to directly target the Spirit Body. Spirit Calling (1 SPI): Urge the spirit to leave its body. The target rolls at -2 if dead, or +6 if alive. Commandeer Spirit (2 SPI): Command a spirit to obey your orders. The target rolls Will at -2 if dead, or +4 if alive. Spirit Enslavement (4 SPI): Enslave a spirit. The target rolls Will at +2 if dead, or +8 if alive. Language of the Dead does not work on higher Sequences. Marionettes are considered undead — roll Ritualistic Magic vs the Marionettist's Ritualistic Magic; +4 to the Marionettist if the marionette has a Spirit Worm core. Resurrection (1-4 SPI): Roll Ritualistic Magic. Turn corpses into Zombies or living skeletons. They have no will or consciousness. Spirit Swapping (2 SPI): Defend against Soul Body attacks by swapping your spirit with an undead under your command.
out.name: Spirit Guide
out.reinforcedAbilities: Spirit Channeling: Directly summon spirits from the Spirit World. Can command the deceased and natural spirits to fight. The undead commanded can have similar status to the Spirit Guide. Number of undead: up to thousands.

out.ability: Giant (Free Action): The Dawn Paladin gains +20 cm in height permanently, and can temporarily gain an additional +20 cm at will. Light of Dawn (1 SPI): Fill an area of roughly 40-50 m with sacred Dawn Light. Inflicts 2d6 burning damage (HT/2 to halve) to Wraiths, Shadows, and Evil Spirits. Reduces corruption by 1d/2 for those in the area. Nullifies concealment effects and dispels illusions. Dawn Armor (2 SPI): Conjure a silver Armor of Dawn with 20 HP. Recovers 4 HP per turn by draining 1 FP (Free Action). Includes gauntlets, breastplate, and helmet. Sword of Dawn (1 SPI): Condense Dawn into a weapon. Each strike is imbued with Purification, dealing +2d burning damage to undead, wraiths, and ghosts. Hurricane of Light (3 SPI): The Dawn Paladin's most powerful attack. Insert the Sword of Dawn into the ground and shatter it, creating a hurricane of light dealing 5d+2 damage (+3d against Shadows and Corrupted entities, +3d against Evil and spirits — up to 8d total). Needs 2 minutes of rest before reuse. The Sword of Dawn cannot be condensed for 10 seconds after activation. The Dawn Paladin can control the hurricane's direction to a certain extent.
out.name: Dawn Paladin

out.ability: Conspiracy (2 SPI): The core of a Conspirer's arsenal — weave deceptions, misdirect attention, and create confusion among enemies. All enemies within 10 m must roll Will-2 or suffer -2 to all Perception, Observation, and skill rolls for 1d turns due to confusion and misdirection. Incitement (1 SPI): Incite certain thoughts or desires in someone's mind through conversation, such as consciously igniting the flames in their heart. Flame Transformation (2 SPI): Merge with fire weapons conjured from Pyrokinesis and travel to the destination where the fire weapon lands. Can take other people, but they take 1d damage from the flames. Initial range: 10 m (30 m when potion is digested).
out.advantages: Acute Vision +2 to vision-based Perception rolls Acute Hearing +2 to hearing-based Perception rolls Acute Taste & Smell +2 to taste/smell-based Perception rolls Acute Touch +2 to touch-based Perception rolls
out.name: Conspirer
out.reinforcedAbilities: Pyrokinesis: Freely control flames within 15 m. Compress (1 SPI): Damage increases to 1d+3. Can multi-turn charge (5/10 bonus damage per turn spent charging, max 10). Conjure (1 SPI): Can now gain weapon skills with conjured weapons and parry with weapons of fire. Use the skill of the weapon the flame transforms into.

out.ability: Cross-breeding (1 SPI): Create chimeras or cross-breeds between various animals, plants, and even objects — directly creating new species. Ordinary materials create unique species with directed abilities. Beyonder ingredients create more magical cross-breeds with unique properties. Before Sequence 4, cross-breeds lack a Soul. The result depends on player intent and GM discretion. Poison Creation (1 SPI): The Biologist's own body can produce highly potent toxin, accumulated and released through hair or other means. Releases poison dealing 1d+1 damage per turn for 1d turns in an area. Leaves the target poisoned for 1d/2 turns after leaving the area.
out.name: Biologist
out.reinforcedAbilities: Knowledge — Life: Deep understanding of living organisms. +6 to Hidden Lore (Living Organism).

out.ability: Natural Sense of Smell (Passive): Differentiate people by their scent. Detect entities unable to hide their smell (e.g., wraiths). Strong odours impose -1 to all rolls. Discerning Spiritual Materials (Passive): Gain vast knowledge to discern spiritual materials for various concoctions. Can now treat terminal illnesses. Potion & Perfume Crafting: Create Potions and Perfumes with extraordinary effects. Roll Alchemy. Success margin determines longevity: 0-2 = 1 day, 3-5 = 3 days, 6-8 = 5 days, 9+ = 1 week, critical success = 2 weeks. Can drink up to 4 potions in battle before facing negative effects. Known Potions include: Solar Water Potion (Alchemy -1): Powerful against undead and vampires — 3d purification damage on contact. Dragon's Breath (Alchemy -1): Spit a fire breath dealing 3d burning (one-time use). Invisibility Potion (Alchemy -3): Become completely invisible. Lasts 1d×10 minutes. Anti-Smell Potion (Alchemy +0): Eliminates the user's smell and body odor. Anti-Dream Potion (Alchemy -2): Prevents Dream Pulling effects. Shadow Potion (Alchemy -4): Allows Shadow Movement at ×2 Base Move. Known Perfumes include: Animal-Friendly Perfume (Alchemy -1): Makes animals calmer and friendlier toward the user (GM discretion). A true Potions Professor can research and invent new Potions and Perfumes (roll Inventor then Alchemy -4, with GM approval).
out.name: Potions Professor

out.ability: Danger Premonition (Malice Perception): The Devil can sense the place of origin of danger and who it comes from. Requires 3 conditions: (1) the threat is fatal or life-threatening, (2) the source intends harm within a certain period and range, (3) the source acts on that intent. The premonition window ranges from a few minutes to 24 hours. The range spans from a few miles to an entire metropolitan area, depending on the individual Devil. Fearless: The Devil does not feel or experience fear. Automatically succeed on all Fright Checks. Devil Bloodline: Each Devil develops unique racial abilities upon advancement. Choose one of the following (or create a new one with GM approval): Shadow-Shifter: When forced into a life-threatening situation, the Devil can escape by leaving only a shadow behind. The Devil reappears at any shadow within 30 meters. Spirit Body (Rare): The Devil can freely switch between body and spirit form like a Wraith. Item Creation: The Devil can skin humans and perform complicated processes to form Beyonder items with usage or time limitations (GM's discretion). Skin Clothes: Anyone wearing a human skin crafted by the Devil can transform into the original person, disguising themselves completely. Devil Transformation (3 SPI): Transform into true Devil form — gigantify the body, sprout bat wings and goat horns. Gain +4 ST, +4 DX, +4 HT, and +2 DR. Spell restrictions are lessened in this form (e.g., launch 10–20 Sulfur Fireballs simultaneously instead of the usual 3). Language of Foulness: Devils speak demonic words originating from the Abyss, filled with Filth and Corruption. They can use the following: Slow (2 SPI): All targets within a 7–8 meter radius turn numb and slow or come to a halt. Reduces Base Speed and Basic Move by 5 for 2 turns. Can only be maintained for 2 seconds. Death (2 SPI): Dodged normally. Target may halve the effect with a HT roll. Inflicts 2d damage per turn for 2 turns. Corruption (3 SPI): An area-of-effect attack causing Abyss Corruption symptoms. Within a 5 meter radius, each target takes 1d damage and +1 CoR, creating black fog. The area persists for 1d turns. Sulfur Fireball (1 SPI per fireball): Launch pale blue Fireballs that explode and poison on contact. No more than 3 at a time. Each inflicts 1d+1 damage, plus poison for 1d-2 damage for 1d-2 turns. Sword of Lava (4 SPI): The Devil cannot move on the same turn. Deals 5d+3 damage. Can be dodged. Flame Cage (3 SPI): Within 10 meters, conjure a large Cage of Flames to block escape. Also blocks projectiles. Poisonous Flame Manipulation (1 SPI, Free Action): Manipulate Poisonous Flames within 30 meters — ignite materials, shape existing flames, or hurl a Poisonous Flame Jet at a target within 30 m (DX or Sleight of Hand to hit).
out.advantages: DR 2 Physical — skin mutated DR 2 Curses, Flames, Poison — highly resistant
out.name: Devil

out.ability: Calamity Attraction (Passive): The Calamity Priest's body passively draws misfortune. At the start of each session (or once per in-game day), the GM rolls 3d6 to determine a calamity that will befall the Priest. The Priest may use their Foresight (Seq 9) to foresee the calamity 1 round in advance, allowing mitigation or avoidance. Active Attraction (2 SPI): Direct calamity at a target within 30 meters. Roll 3d6: 3–6 — Major: A genuine hazard — e.g., a carriage wheel flies off toward the target, a gas lamp explodes showering glass, a heavy crate falls from a pulley. GM determines damage (2d6–3d6 depending on environment). 7–14 — Moderate: Noticeable misfortune — e.g., a floorboard rots through underfoot (-2 to Move), a chandelier cord snaps (1d6, Dodge to halve), a chimney pot crashes beside them. 15–18 — Minor: Annoyance or fizzle — e.g., a pigeon swarm spooks their horse, a gust slams a window shut in their face (-1 to next roll). On 17–18 the calamity backfires on the Priest instead. The Priest cannot foresee or mitigate actively attracted calamities. +3 to the roll in hazard-rich areas (docks, factory, cliffside), -3 in sparse areas (empty field, open room). Psyche Storm (2 SPI): Assault the target's Spirit Body directly. Inflicts 1d-2 SPI damage (reducing the target's Spirituality pool) and applies -3 to all the target's rolls for the next 2 turns. At the end of each turn, the target may roll Will-3 — on success, the penalty ends early.
out.name: Calamity Priest

out.ability: Ice Control: The Zombie can control ice they are in physical contact with, gaining the following abilities: Contact-Freeze (Free Action, 1 SPI): Any physical attack that contacts a target's skin can freeze their body. On a successful Brawling/Boxing/Wrestling roll the Zombie freezes a body part — target's physical rolls at -1. Stacks with repeated hits. Ice Stun (3 SPI): Seal opponents in ice on physical contact. Target breaks free with ST-4. Ice Wall (X SPI): Freeze water into ice walls with 5 HP per SPI spent. Ice Floor (2 SPI): Create slippery ice layers. Targets must succeed Acrobatics or fall. The Zombie can spend 1 SPI to control the ice beneath their feet (Free Action). Ice Temperature (2 SPI): Lower air temperature, causing strong winds and snowflakes. Cold-sensitive targets roll Will or suffer -1 to all rolls in the zone. Decay, Rot & Withering: Wither Explosion (2 SPI): Make mid-range air explode into black wisps inducing Withering. Inflicts 1d6-1 damage for 1d/2 turns. Rotting Body Aura (Free Action, 1 SPI): Effuse a rotting aura — add 1d Decay damage to the next attack. Aura of Decay (1 SPI): Emit an aura that visibly withers surrounding vegetation. Sludge Creation (1 SPI): Create rotting sludge. Targets must roll ST, DX, or Acrobatics or have Base Move halved in the sludge area. Zombie Manipulation: Awaken the dead (1 SPI), cultivate puppets, control ghosts, and command them (0 SPI).
out.advantages: DR 3 Physical — natural hardened body armor Regeneration (Very Fast) Recover 1 HP per second
out.drawbacks: Sun Vulnerability Sun-domain abilities deal double damage and ignore DR; regeneration is suspended for 1 minute after a Sun-domain hit Zombie's Curse Every Full Moon, the Zombie endures great pain. If resisting, they lose the ability to fight — roll Will-2 for any action. Replaces the Lunatic's and Werewolf curses
out.name: Zombie

out.effect: Spiritual Attrition: -3 to all SPI-based skill rolls and Beyonder ability checks
Spiritual Exhaustion: All Beyonder abilities deactivate
Soul Debt: +1 CoR per 1 point below 0 (e.g. SPI -4 = +4 CoR). See CoR (Chapter 6).
Reeling: -1 to all rolls
You risk unconsciousness; roll against HT every turn to stay awake
Mortal wound state; roll against HT to stay alive. If unconscious: one chance to wake after 12 hours; failure = coma (external stabilization or HT rolls every 12 hours to avoid death)
One survival roll per additional multiple of total HP dropped below zero
Automatic death — no roll required

out.ability: Spiritual Intuition
out.text: Spiritual Intuition is a universal ability available to any Beyonder, like Spirit Vision. It lets the user sense the flow of fate and changes in destiny before they manifest physically — the soul's early-warning system — and recognise a threat at a glance. Beyonders of the Abyss and Wheel of Fortune pathways are famed for the sharpness of their intuition, but the ability itself belongs to no single pathway. Roll: Roll 3d6. The difficulty class is based on however much current SPI you have — if you have 1 SPI, you need a critical roll (3–4); if you have 9 SPI, you need 9 or lower; and so on.

out.ability: Spiritual Perception
out.text: Spiritual Perception is a universal ability available to any Beyonder, like Spirit Vision. It is an acute awareness of the spiritual world — ghosts, traces of magic, and supernatural phenomena — and lets the user peer into the Astral Body and Spiritual Body of beings, reading their emotional state and spiritual health. Roll: Roll 3d6. The difficulty class is based on however much current SPI you have — if you have 1 SPI, you need a critical roll (3–4); if you have 9 SPI, you need 9 or lower; and so on. The GM calls for this roll whenever supernatural events occur nearby, or whenever you deliberately open your senses to the spiritual world. DANGER: Spiritual Perception can expose the viewer to beings far beyond their comprehension. Looking upon the Spiritual Body of a deity, angel, or sufficiently powerful entity may force a Fright Check at a severe penalty or cause spiritual damage. The GM determines the exact effects based on the entity's nature and the observer's Sequence.
